_comment: Assigned function block + spatial slot per VMID. Deliberately hand-authored, NOT derived
from the PVE API: API ordering reshuffles on every create/destroy, which would destroy the
spatial memory that is the only reason to render the lab in space rather than as a list.
This file is also the answer to open decision 1 in the VR Lab doc: guests group by their
ASSIGNED function block, not their live VMID. Live VMIDs for Media are 100-110 against a
21x target and renumbering is deferred indefinitely (a VMID is fixed at creation, so
renumber means destroy+recreate) — grouping by live VMID would bake that mismatch in.
A guest present in PVE but absent here lands in `staging` and is reported in `warnings`.
Place it deliberately; do not let the renderer invent a position.
_offcluster_comment: Load-bearing hosts that are NOT Proxmox guests, so they have no VMID and never appear in
any pct-based enumeration. L0 has to render these or the lab is a lie of omission.
lab-graph reports them as declared-only: it does not probe them (that is a health concern,
not a topology one) and marks their `source` accordingly.

offcluster.role: Inference — RTX 3060 Ti + GTX 1660 SUPER. Both GPUs must stay usable.
Palworld dedicated server on bare metal (ex-mission-control laptop). Took over LXC 234's mesh address at cutover.
offcluster.note: On the .86 mesh, not the .50 LAN. LXC 234 was destroyed 2026-07-26 (iac#191) — its rootfs held no game data.

_iac_comment: L4 coverage: what is actually controlled. Three states — 'iac' (declared and applied from
petedio-iac or petedio-media-iac), 'brownfield' (imported in place at its live VMID/IP),
and 'none'. Hand-maintained: there is no API that can answer this.
